test_title: PYST 17: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
A box is made by folding the given sheet. In the box so formed, select the face that will be opposite to the face having four dots.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d15757c31f632666acbe8c958ece4f646b484cab39daed88d82ee631d9828f4.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/960c6eb96e62ddcd7e6ccdd5c857d87ac96367414b4117f1788f80e1e184375d.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions becomes opposite to each other and the remaining two faces becomes opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

 
• One dot → Two dots
 
• Three dots → Five dots
 
• Four dots → Six dots

Therefore,

 
• Option(1) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1216828a96c8311d096f08a757fad5fc0fad535f37c9f19c7121ae56b8c734ca.png] - Five dots faces three dots, so it does not face four dots
 
• Option(2) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecd024b600ba6674db9ade3c6d38b05615a6e74d1f1bf651cab544c25f816b4e.png] - One dot faces two dots , so it does not face four dots
 
• Option(3) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e855af42eddbf7defec5b5d7436536c0f431297b5cda9911f0a2c3d98c62fa4.png] - Three dots faces five dots, so it does face four dots
 
• Option (4) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/04ffd256267420926893e369b858338abcf01b8a61fef23ae5c40b298415d18b.png] - Six dots faces four dots

Hence, "Option - (4)" is the correct answer.
